scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with a finite supplemental checker. No independent audit, publication, experimental proof of infinity, or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Unit-integral centered order-three B-spline on the exact unit rectangular lattice only; the spectral measure is the normalized Zak-fiber mean, not an operator trace. Full text of an especially relevant recent spline Zak-zero paper was inaccessible, leaving a publication-priority risk.
title: Logarithmic spectral saddle of the critical quadratic-spline Gabor operator
